subject.title: Rename i18n locale codes from region-based (zh-CN/zh-TW) to script-based (zh-Hans/zh-Hant)

question: Should OpenClaw make `zh-Hans` and `zh-Hant` the canonical Chinese locale IDs across Control UI, CLI wizard inputs, generated i18n artifacts, docs, and saved browser preferences?
rationale: The rename is technically reasonable, but it changes shipped public IDs, documented setup inputs, and persisted browser preferences, so automation should not choose the alias and migration policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve coordinated script-code migration
options.body: Make `zh-Hans` and `zh-Hant` canonical and require one migration PR that updates runtime, docs, generated artifacts, tests, and old-value handling together.

options.title: Keep region-code public IDs
options.body: Leave `zh-CN` and `zh-TW` as public runtime and CLI IDs while accepting script-form input only as aliases that resolve to existing IDs.

options.title: Split docs metadata from runtime IDs
options.body: Limit script-based naming to docs or platform metadata while keeping runtime and CLI locale IDs unchanged.

recommendation.title: Approve coordinated script-code migration
recommendation.body: Make `zh-Hans` and `zh-Hant` canonical and require one migration PR that updates runtime, docs, generated artifacts, tests, and old-value handling together.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice crosses public setup docs, CLI onboarding behavior, browser persisted preferences, and compatibility policy rather than only generated locale files.
